More precisely, it is the Dee–Kelley work received in 1583 and preserved as **British Library Sloane MS 3189**. The British Library titles it *The Book of Enoch* and identifies it as *Liber Mysteriorum Sextus et Sanctus* / *Liber Logaeth*, transcribed by Edward Kelley.
